Lancaster County, Virginia Tax Sales: Your Essential Guide

Interested in participating in tax sales in Lancaster County, Virginia? This guide provides a clear overview to help you navigate the process.

​

Click Here to Get Dustin Hahn’s Tax Lien and Deed FREE Mini-Course

Understanding Tax Sales in Lancaster County

Lancaster County schedules tax sales as needed, without a fixed annual date. These sales offer opportunities to purchase properties with delinquent taxes.​

Auction Details

  • Timing: Auctions typically begin at 10:00 AM Eastern Time. Always verify the exact time in the official auction announcement.​
  • Location: Sales are conducted as simulcast auctions, allowing both online and in-person participation. In-person auctions are held at the Board of Supervisors Meeting Room, Lancaster County Administration Building, 8311 Mary Ball Road, Lancaster, VA 22503. ​TACS+1lancova.com+1

Registration Requirements

To participate, you must register before the auction. Registration periods vary, so consult the specific auction notice for deadlines.​

Bidding Process and Payment Terms

  • Bidding: Properties are sold to the highest bidder.​
  • Deposit: The winning bidder must pay a deposit of 25% of the purchase price or $1,000 (whichever is higher), along with a 10% buyer’s premium (minimum $150).​
  • Payment: Full payment is required within 15 days after court confirmation of the sale. Accepted payment methods include certified funds, cashier’s checks, money orders, or wire transfers. ​

Property Redemption

Property owners can redeem their property by paying all outstanding taxes, penalties, interest, and costs at any time before the auction.​

Important Considerations

  • As-Is Sales: All properties are sold “as-is.” Conduct thorough research before bidding.​
  • Due Diligence: Investigate properties thoroughly to understand potential risks and benefits.​

Contact Information

For more details, contact Taxing Authority Consulting Services (TACS):

  • Email: taxsales@taxva.com​
  • Phone: (804) 548-4418​

Staying Informed

Regularly visit the Lancaster County Treasurer’s Office website for updates on tax sales and other related information. ​lancova.com
